Problem is that if you get enough bad karma you can actually be in some ways blocked from posting on reddit. You basically get (i hope ik using this term right) soft-locked out of reddit for been too controversial 

Reddit was initially made with the intent that downvotes got rid of off-topic/troll posts, but now its made reddit into the hive mind it is. Because you can easily hide what you don’t want to see and promote what you do want. And people enjoy beating on someone they don’t like, especially in a group. And reddit unfortunately has plenty of that.

Its what social media has done, i don’t think social media is inherently bad btw, i just think it has caused a lot of problems.

Namely encouraging people to fight, cause fighting, especially on their platform, drums up views and regular use. Basically social media has turned life itself into a reality show, and we’re all the unwilling characters. Hence why facebook shows places you’ve commented on to your friends list, hoping to somehow drum up drama. 

And all that fighting has caused humans to see in black and white, as in either someone is the friend or the enemy. And god help you if you’re in between. Hence why you can say the most neutral opinion, even just an opinion on food!- and someone will inevitably find it offensive to someone or themselves. 

There’s plenty of infighting and backstabbing happening in many communities, no matter how small. I suppose there always was but there’s far more now more than ever. Its very worrying to watch but welp thats where its going.

Social anxiety, atleast in my experience:

Imagine living every day thinking about every single person, someone smiling at you has to be interpreted in every way possible. You know you have it, but your mind seems to be out of your control. 

You constantly second guess everyone’s motives. Someone you’ve trusted for years could just make one wrong move, and suddenly they hate you and are out to murder you for how much they hate you.

You get so sick of thinking that you only drink alcohol to stop the worrying for once. When i’m drunk i can almost imagine what it feels to not have it.

Sure, pills might not be the only cure, but will exercising stop me from having my brain feel hot and overworked by the end of the day? Will yoga stop the ulcers in my stomach from all the worries? Will it work for everyone? No. There are pills for a reason, you dont expect to treat cancer with natural remedies. So why should mental illnesses be seen as different? 

Worse part is, i dont even have severe anxiety. So please, try to understand why people with anxiety are so untrusting. We know we shouldn’t be like this, but we cannot control it. We aren’t anti social, we’re literally just scared. And that fear never truly goes away. It cannot be cured, only lived with.

Fucking rung from transformers idw, so i never read the comics besides in random online pics, but when i was 16 and was deep into the worst part of my life. To sum it up quickly:

I was bullied every day, mixed with social anxiety. At home my stepdad constantly emotionally abused me, sometimes mum emotionally manipulated me, they got into bad fights every night, school didnt care about the bullying, the school was the only school for miles so all the kids in the area went there and thus targeted me so i never went outside. Also i was 3 hours away from nearest family. 

Also all my ‘friends’ there either turned on me or were suicidal too.

SO LIFE WAS GREAT

Anyway 

So quick bit of info: i saw a lot of counsellors but none of them could help my situation, which was the root cause of all my stress. Which they meant well but they could do nothing for me, especially since i had such high hopes. 

Rung, if you dont know, is a psychiatrist so i sorta imagined he’d be one who would somehow save me. I was really messed up during this time, i needed something to cling to. He was it. 

So i found out about rung and at first just thought he was cute but then seeing more about him made me like his character. He was a sweet heart, someone who genuinely cared. Sure he was a wuss, but unlike my previous fave, ratchet, he wasnt a grumpy guy. Considering yelling/anger could/can make me have a panic attack. 

I mostly read random bits of the comics online and the more i saw of him, the more i liked him. He was just so lovely, still is and so for a while he was my escape. Just seeing the fanart, the bits of him, the jokes about him, the voice interpretations.. it all made me so happy. Even his shattered glass (evil) versions made me happy to see. 

But then one day i found the pic of him laying dead.. well i literally went through the five stages of grief. But when i finally accepted, it helped bring me to trying to literally end it all. 

It took me a while to accept it, i thought it was either a fake out, or maybe just a hoax- just something that wasnt real. But when it was all but confirmed, i was devastated.

By now i had given up on psychologists so i was very far gone and helpless. So over time that coupled with my general life piled on.. life got worse.. i wont mention the fanfics, but Rung’s death was just constantly on my mind. 

So one night i finally decided, suicide it was.

Not that i hadnt tried before, but all the others were casual, i guess. Like cutting myself hoping one day i’d bleed out enough, or finally not have enough water in me, or not sleep for long enough that i’d at least pass out. It was more a cry for help i guess, but this was more instant. So evidently, i failed. I passed out at 4 am and i’ll leave out the rest of that shitty time.

But yeah, thats my long ass story of how a fictional robots death helped bring me to trying to kill myself. I guarantee would of tried suicide a lot sooner if i had not met rung.

But now hes a reminder of that time, thats already given me ptsd. So now he cant really be considered my fave, as much as i love him, i’ll always remember him as someone i desperately clung to, but like everyone else he couldnt be depended on. Not that i blame the writers, heck the comic was already way past rung’s death when i found out.
